dateSource: Camera-local EXIF DateTimeOriginal for 111 selections. Two camera panoramas use EXIF Image DateTime, corroborated by their original PANO filenames. Redmi originals have no UTC offset tag; +08:00 is inferred from Malaysia and corroborated by GPS UTC time where usable. Metadata-free copies and the screenshot were omitted.
locationNotes: Original GPS, landmarks, signs and capture order establish Melaka, Kuala Lumpur and Batu Caves, George Town and northern Penang, Penang Hill, and Langkawi.
GPS can be stale or imprecise, especially on the boat route. No individual Kilim cave is named without reliable site evidence; the park or Langkawi coast is used instead.
Official tourism and attraction references support landmark names; the photographs establish the visits and dates.

No itinerary or completed archive was present or used. All 634 extracted still images were reviewed in eight contact sheets; 128 candidates were inspected at larger size, including the replacement street-art frame. The cover was checked separately at 1500 pixels.
Originals, videos, exact GPS coordinates and review sheets remain outside the website and R2. Only approved WebP derivatives are uploaded.
criteria: Prefer clear, distinct architecture, scenery, interiors, food, details and local daily life; compare repeated bursts before selection.
Aim for about ten photographs per day or location when supported by strong distinct scenes; shorter sections avoid repetition.
Use the SkyBridge cover exactly once in the total and in its capture day’s count, without repeating it in the gallery.
Preserve framing and colour, correct EXIF orientation, resize to at most 2000 pixels on the long edge or 2400 for the cover, and export WebP at quality 84 without EXIF/XMP.
Visible local people, crowds and incidental visitors are allowed. Prominent people and visitor scenes are listed for later review; no face matching is performed.
omissionReasons: Metadata-free copies and the screenshot lack reliable camera-local capture dates and often have lower resolution or altered colour.
Near-identical bursts, weaker versions of selected views, blurred or obstructed frames, tilted accidental views, transit logistics and posed portraits were omitted.
The single 21 November coffee photograph was omitted rather than creating a transit-only section.
Videos are outside the still-photo album.
